items: Fast Dry & Moisture Wicking： Outdoor Ventures men's hiking shirt provides moisture wicking properties for added next-to-skin comfort in fishing shirts. It pulls the sweat from your skin into the fabric surface where it evaporates through air flow and dries quickly. It will definitely be a great shirt in humid weather.

items.label: Breathable & Cooling
items.value: Outdoor Ventures fishing shirt for men is a great summertime cooling button-up shirt. Unique tech fabric with air holes allow for extreme breathability, carrying away internal heat to make you feel cool and comfortable on hot summer days.

items: UV Sun Protection：Our short sleeve shirts for men are made with full sunshade UPF 50+ fabric, which offers maximum sun protection by blocking harmful UVA and UVB rays for fishing and any other outdoor recreation.

items.label: Utility Outdoor Shirts
items.value: 2 velcro-closure pockets, sunglasses loop, multiple pen holders and a rod holder on the front for storage. A built-in glasses cleaning cloth at the hem makes it easy for cleaning glasses or shades.

items.label: Lightweight & Water Resistant
items.value: Featuring light，soft and water resistant material,this shirt is great for hiking, fishing, hunting, safari, camping, travel, working, casual, cycling, climbing,etc.It’s also stain repellent and wrinkle free, making it easy to clean and wash.
